name: Wounded Ancients
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
It seems obvious to me that the protectors of the Vale--the treants--had something to do with the Venture Co. being driven back. Unfortunately, even those once great guardians have now become corrupt.

Gaxim thinks their corruption is somehow linked to the weapons the goblins used during their retreat.

I told him I'd collect a sample from a wounded treant and allow him to study it in order to figure out if that's true.

Bring me some of the shrapnel so the gnome can tell me more...
narrative.objectives: Bring a piece of Corroded Shrapnel to Kaela Shadowspear in Stonetalon.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you, adventurer.

This should be more than sufficient for Gaxim to figure out how the treants were corrupted. I shall give this to him right away.
narrative.requestItemsText: I have a feeling Gaxim will find a use for the shrapnel regardless of how the Venture Co. has used it in the past.
